text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One New Year's morning,
Seiun Sky suddenly got in touch,
asking if I wanted to go for Hatsumode—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're here.
Happy New Year~!
choice_data_list: What's gotten into you all of a sudden?
What's the matter all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean 'what's wrong'...
Hey now~ isn't that a little rude?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: An Umamusume invited her Trainer to Hatsumode to pray for a breakthrough year. That's all there is to it, right?
choice_data_list: Any other umamusume would be satisfied, but...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Are you saying Sei-chan isn't a normal Umamusume!?
That's genuinely rude, you know!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...I was just thinking that I'll use anything I can get my hands on,
even the Gods~ That's all."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Looks like I won't make it in the Senior Class unless I start using my head a lot more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having clashed with formidable rivals
in the Classics and the Arima Kinen,
Seiun Sky surely has a lot on her mind in her own way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For Seiun Sky's sake,
what I should pray for is—
choice_data_list: I hope Seiun Sky can take on the challenge without overdoing it.
I hope Seiun Sky can really shine.
I hope Seiun Sky can enjoy the race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One's body is their greatest asset. I hoped
Seiun Sky would continue to take on challenges
without overexerting himself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This year will put her true strength to the test even
more. I prayed that Seiun Sky would be able to
demonstrate all the power she possesses.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Mm.
I guess the rest is up to the gods now.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Of course, it's a secret~.
Because if I say it out loud, it won't come true.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well... I'm probably feeling the exact same
as you, Trainer. Most definitely.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, as we briefly discussed this year's plans on our way back to the academy—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hm? That is...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Sei-chan...!
Good morning!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Special Week. Just the other day, she announced her entry into the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Mornin'. Doing some self-training?
Working hard even on New Year's Day, huh~

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Because this year—
I absolutely refuse to lose to Sei-chan!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I was watching the Arima Kinen.
You looked so cool, Sei-chan!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The pressure must have been immense.
Yet Sei-chan stayed true to her own running style the whole way.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Watching it sent shivers down my spine!
It made me realize I need to get so much stronger...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I want to beat Sei-chan at the Tenno Sho (Spring). If I do, I feel like... I'll be one step closer to becoming the best in Japan!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Special Week pours her feelings out directly.
However, Seiun Sky—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Thanks~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well then, do your best with your training.
...Let's go, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hmm~? What about it?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...We'd just get in the way of training.
We can talk as much as we want back at the academy."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"And besides...
you said 'I have to become stronger'... right?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It's because I watched that Arima Kinen.
Spe-chan must have felt everyone's sheer drive, too.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...As for me...
I'm~ getting really hungry.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I look at Spe-chan's face, I get hungry.
Probably because that girl's always eating something.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Guess I'll go grab a bite to eat at the dorm cafeteria.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well Trainer-san,
here's to another great year together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What was Seiun Sky feeling?
I don't know right now, but I resolved to keep a close eye on her this year so I can always support her.
